headings: This is A Box of Pens
text: These are my keys, My friends joke they are 'man keys' due to the fact that I only have one unnessecary thing on them a tag with my family belt buckle and tartan that my parents got for me in scotland. It has my car keys, my apartment keys, and a couple others. This unlocks all the nessecary doors in my life which is why I have it with me every day
This is my wireless mouse, the trackpad on my laptop has been getting finnicky recently and this has been a real life saver. Having to work on my computer every day makes it vital to my livelyhood

This is a box of pens from the brand MUJI. They are a really small size which is uncommon in the US. I became accustomed to this size pen after I bought some on my trip to Japan this past summer and couldn't go back. The problem was that I had run out of said pen and their shipping costs are astronomical. Luckily one of their few US stores was across the street from a restaurant I met a friend at in boston over fall break.
